speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you tell me exactly when your fatigue, flank pain, and fever started, and which antibiotic you were prescribed for your sinusitis?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any pain or burning when you urinate, and have you noticed any changes in the color or clarity of your urine? I also need to know if you have experienced any nausea or vomiting alongside these symptoms.

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did the rash appear shortly after starting amoxicillin, and have you noticed any swelling in your face, lips, or extremities since then? I also need to know if your urine output has decreased or if it appears cloudy or bloody.

speaker: Patient
text: I do not have nausea, vomiting, or burning with urination. I also have not noticed a major change in urine color.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the history of amoxicillin use followed by fever and flank pain without typical urinary symptoms, I suspect Acute Interstitial Nephritis. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis_and_Urinalysis_Microscopy.
